Class AgiClassSourceParameterRenderer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractParameterRenderer<AgiClassSource>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AgiClassSourceParameterRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<AgiClassSource>
public class AgiClassSourceParameterRenderer extends AbstractParameterRenderer<AgiClassSource>
A specialized parameter renderer for individual AgiClassSource descriptors.

This renderer wraps the Java class source in a virtual StringHandle and leverages the host-specific ResourceUI strategy (NetBeans editor or RSyntaxTextArea) to provide 100% IDE fidelity including syntax highlighting, line numbers, and inline editing.

Hierarchical Value Propagation: When the user modifies the source code in the UI, saving triggers AbstractParameterRenderer.valueChanged(Object), cleanly emitting a new immutable AgiClassSource instance up to its parent list container or directly to the tool call.
